subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep this as an operator-controlled workaround?
rationale: The code surface is small, but changing browser launch defaults affects all managed/sandbox Chrome users and the existing `browser.extraArgs` path already covers local managed profiles.

options.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
options.body: Run live Chrome proof and then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Document operator control only
options.body: Keep defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported server-mode mitigation.

options.title: Add a dedicated config knob
options.body: Introduce a specific browser model-download suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing config surface is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
recommendation.body: Run live Chrome proof and then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on the managed browser surface and the prior related PR review that redirected the stale patch to the browser-plugin path.
